name: glygen_gtex
description: GlyGen glyco gene sets (standalone and tissue-enriched via GTEx) from NIH/NIGMS Common Fund reviewed data

inputs.name: gtex_tstat_tsv
inputs.description: Tab-delimited GTEx t-statistic matrix (genes x tissues), derived from GTEx V8 median TPM. Accepts a local path or the canonical URL: https://storage.googleapis.com/adult-gtex/bulk-gex/v8/rna-seq/GTEx_Analysis_2017-06-05_v8_RNASeQCv1.1.9_gene_median_tpm.gct.gz

parameters.name: tstat_threshold
parameters.help: Minimum GTEx t-statistic for a GlyGen gene to be included in a tissue-enriched (x_gtex) set. Default 4.0. Standalone sets include all GlyGen catalog members regardless of threshold.

outputs.name: standalone/<set>/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: All genes in this GlyGen category (no tissue filter)

outputs.name: standalone/<set>/geneset.tsv
outputs.description: Gene list for the standalone GlyGen set

outputs.name: x_gtex/<set>_x_GTEx_enriched_<tissue>/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: GlyGen genes tissue-enriched (t >= threshold) in this tissue

outputs.name: x_gtex/<set>_x_GTEx_enriched_<tissue>/geneset.tsv
outputs.description: Gene list for the tissue-enriched x GTEx set
